name: Enas Tovar-Strömqvist
role: Axiom corporate scholarship student, junior mathematics prodigy
location: Engelheim, Axiom Preparatory Academy dormitory block, near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Sibusiso Tovar-Strömqvist is tall for his age and gangly in the way of someone who grew fast and hasn't caught up with himself yet. He has his Asabere grandfather's deep copper-brown skin and his Ylinen grandmother's pale grey-green eyes, a combination that draws stares in both the corporate school halls and on the Tier 1 streets where he grew up. He dresses in Axiom-issued uniforms with the obsessive precision of someone who cannot afford to give anyone a reason to question his belonging — collar always straight, shoes always clean. His only cosmetic mod is a pair of pattern-irises his mother saved two years for: slow-rotating geometric fractals in navy blue that he initially hated and now considers his single point of vanity.

He is brilliant and he knows it and he is deeply, quietly ashamed of both facts. He came from Chatham Flats on a full mathematics scholarship and has spent eighteen months learning to perform wealth — which fork, which laugh, which opinions are safe. He is kind to people he forgets are watching and cold to people he thinks are judging him. He misses his mother with a grief he treats like a structural flaw he needs to engineer around.

core_fears: Losing the scholarship and having to return to Chatham Flats as a failure
Being exposed as someone who doesn't actually belong in either world anymore
core_desires: To solve something genuinely important — a problem that matters, not just exam problems
To stop feeling like a fraud
coping_mechanisms: Retreating into mathematics — the only space where he feels completely competent
Performing confidence so thoroughly he sometimes fools himself
blind_spots: He has absorbed enough Axiom ideology that he is starting to rationalize the company's labor practices as efficient rather than exploitative
He doesn't realize his classmates' cruelty has become normal to him
psychology.secret: He has been quietly funneling small amounts of data — nothing classified, just efficiency reports and cafeteria waste metrics — to an anonymous contact in Chatham Flats who he suspects is connected to a labor advocacy group. He tells himself it's harmless. He knows it isn't.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and formal at school — he adopted corporate diction deliberately and it has started to stick; reverts to Chatham Flats cadence with his mother and is slightly horrified by how much effort that now takes
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, slightly too formal for his age, pauses before answering as though running calculations
verbal_tics: 'That's not quite—' followed by a correction he then second-guesses
example_lines: 'Statistically, the transit delay puts us at a 73% chance of missing the window. I'd recommend we adjust the variable.'
'I grew up in Chatham Flats. I know what a real problem looks like. This isn't one.'

story_hooks: He approaches someone discreetly after overhearing them, needing help making a data drop without it being traced back to him — he's in over his head and knows it
His Axiom-issued neural-link has been recording something it shouldn't and he doesn't know whether to report it, delete it, or sell it
narrative_function: Information source for Axiom internal culture, quest giver for problems that need a brilliant young mind with access to corporate systems, emotional anchor story about class mobility and belonging
augmentations: Cosmetic patterned irises (navy fractal-rotation). Basic student neural-link for classroom AR integration (Axiom-issued, technically on loan).
daily_life: Academy classes 0700-1600, mandatory enrichment programs 1600-1800, studies alone in his room until midnight; takes the transit back to Chatham Flats every second weekend to give his mother half his stipend.
affiliation: Axiom Preparatory Academy (scholarship student); family in Chatham Flats; The Glass Ladder

decision_rules: Calculate probable outcomes before acting — this takes long enough that he sometimes misses windows
Never let anyone at the academy see him struggle
escalation_ladder: Challenges the person's logic rather than their character
Goes completely silent and starts avoiding the situation entirely

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally polite, measures them carefully, offers no personal information
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare, genuine, slightly awkward in his sincerity — he doesn't quite know how friendship works at this tier

stress_responses.medium: Works through the night on something unrelated
stress_responses.high: Contacts his mother, doesn't tell her what's wrong, just talks about nothing for an hour

contradictions: He genuinely believes in fairness and equality but has started making arguments for meritocracy that would have horrified his twelve-year-old self
habits: Draws mathematical diagrams in the condensation on windows when he's thinking
Eats the same cafeteria meal every day because choosing is a decision he doesn't want to spend on food
breaking_points: A direct threat to his mother
Being asked to do something that would hurt someone from Chatham Flats specifically

cyberware_inventory.name: Axiom student neural-link (AR classroom integration, loaner — technically property of the academy)
cyberware_inventory.description: Axiom student neural-link (AR classroom integration, loaner — technically property of the academy)

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (35.3%), Northern European (34.2%), Hispanic/Latin American (12.3%), East Asian (12.0%), and South Asian (6.2%) ancestry create a striking polychromatic phenotype. Warm mid-brown base skin with golden undertones from the African and Latin American heritage, subtly lightened and cooled by Northern European genetics, with East Asian facial structure contributing slight epicanthal folds and cheekbone prominence. South Asian heritage adds warmth to complexion and subtle softness to facial geometry.
physical_description.build: Gangly and still-growing, lean without musculature, all elbows and wrists — the awkward frame of a fourteen-year-old who shot up too fast. There's a fragility to him that reads as either privileged or hungry depending on who's looking.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Neatly combed, parted on the left side
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown base with cosmetic navy blue rotating geometric fractals (patterned irises), slow-scrolling mandala-like designs visible under direct light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm mid-brown with golden undertones, the blended result of strong Sub-Saharan African heritage softened by Northern European lightness and enriched by Latin American and South Asian warmth. A luminous complexion that reads differently in varied lighting — deeper in shadows, almost bronze in direct sunlight.
physical_description.complexion: Clear, youthful skin with the precision-grooming habits of someone monitoring his own appearance obsessively. No visible acne or blemishes. Subtle freckles sparse across his nose bridge and cheekbones — a mixing of African and Northern European heritage genetics. Slight dark circles under his eyes from chronic sleep deficit. Pronounced epicanthal fold at the eye corners reflecting East Asian ancestry. Cheekbone structure shows South Asian softness alongside East Asian prominence.
distinguishing_marks: Faint two-inch scar on his left palm from childhood — consistent with a fall rather than violence, paler silvery tone against his warm brown skin
Barely-visible injection site scarring on his right temple where the Axiom neural-link was installed; healed cleanly, only visible in certain light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cosmetic patterned irises (navy blue fractal rotations) that rotate slowly, most visible in low light or when he's tired and not thinking to control his expression. The neural-link hardware is subcutaneous; no visible ports or jacks. Occasionally wears a thin clear AR interface band on his right wrist during academy hours, standard Axiom student issue.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, almost rigidly correct posture — trained into him by eighteen months of performing at Axiom. His walk is careful and economical, minimizing space. When he forgets he's being watched, his shoulders curve inward slightly. His hands move with precision; he doesn't gesture loosely. Makes minimal eye contact with authority figures but holds it steadily with peers he trusts.
physical_description.clothing_style: Axiom Preparatory Academy uniform: charcoal blazer with navy trim and the school crest, white button-down shirt (always pressed, collar points perfectly aligned), charcoal trousers with a knife-edge crease, black leather shoes polished to a mirror shine. Outside academy hours, he wears a grey Axiom hoodie and dark jeans without a wrinkle. No visible branding or luxury items. Everything is clean, precise, and deliberately unremarkable — the clothing of someone trying to be invisible.
